title: Affine subspace Fourier vanishing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $a$ and $\gamma$ be vectors in that space. If $\gamma$ is not orthogonal to every vector in $H$ under the standard dot product, then the Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the indicator function of the affine subspace $a+H$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is not in the orthogonal subspace of $H$
